*[Version française](fr-reference-harmonisation.html)*

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
options(qesR.lang = params$lang)
```

The harmonized variables ("targets") of `qes_harmonize()`, study by study.
The page is generated from the rules that ship with qesR, so it always
describes what the installed version applies.

```{r reference, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
fr <- identical(params$lang, "fr")
md <- strsplit(qesR:::.spec_reference_md(lang = params$lang, site = TRUE), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
# The page is long: a jump list of the variables at the top, and the
# coverage or mapping table of each variable folded in a <details>.
head_re <- "^(#{3,4}) `([^`]+)`: (.*) \\{#((target|relaxed)-[^}]+)\\}\\s*$"
section_re <- "^#{2,3} [^`]"
jump <- character()
group <- NULL
for (line in md) {
  if (grepl(head_re, line)) {
    if (!is.null(group)) {
      jump <- c(jump, paste0("\n**", group, "**\n"))
      group <- NULL
    }
    jump <- c(jump, sub(head_re, "- [`\\2`](#\\4): \\3", line))
  } else if (grepl(section_re, line)) {
    group <- sub("^#+ ", "", line)
  }
}
fold <- c(Coverage = "Coverage by study", `Relaxed mappings` = "Mappings by study",
          Couverture = "Couverture par étude", `Appariements souples` = "Appariements par étude")
out <- character()
open <- FALSE
for (i in seq_along(md)) {
  line <- md[i]
  label <- sub("^\\*\\*(.*)\\*\\*\\s*$", "\\1", line)
  after <- md[seq_along(md) > i & nzchar(trimws(md))]
  if (grepl("^\\*\\*.*\\*\\*\\s*$", line) && label %in% names(fold) &&
      length(after) && startsWith(after[1], "|")) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("<details class=\"qesr-target\"><summary>", fold[[label]], "</summary>"), "")
    open <- TRUE
    next
  }
  # the folded table ends at the first text after it that is not a table row
  if (open && nzchar(trimws(line)) && !startsWith(line, "|")) {
    out <- c(out, "", "</details>")
    open <- FALSE
  }
  out <- c(out, line)
}
if (open) out <- c(out, "", "</details>")
cat(if (fr) "## Aller à une variable\n\n" else "## Jump to a variable\n\n",
    "::: {.qesr-jump}\n", paste(jump, collapse = "\n"), "\n:::\n\n",
    paste(out, collapse = "\n"), sep = "")
```
